hits.doc:
The Mellin transform of a function `f` (for a complex exponent `s`), defined as the integral of
`t ^ (s - 1) • f` over `Ioi 0`.
hits.name: mellin
hits.type: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] (f : ℝ → E) (s : ℂ) : E

hits.name: mellin_comp_inv
hits.type: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] (f : ℝ → E) (s : ℂ) : mellin (fun t => f t⁻¹) s = mellin f (-s)

hits.name: mellin_div_const
hits.type: (f : ℝ → ℂ) (s a : ℂ) : mellin (fun t => f t / a) s = mellin f s / a

hits.name: hasMellin_sub
hits.type: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] {f g : ℝ → E} {s : ℂ} (hf : MellinConvergent f s) (hg : MellinConvergent g s) : HasMellin (fun t => f t - g t) s (mellin f s - mellin g s)

hits.name: hasMellin_add
hits.type: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] {f g : ℝ → E} {s : ℂ} (hf : MellinConvergent f s) (hg : MellinConvergent g s) : HasMellin (fun t => f t + g t) s (mellin f s + mellin g s)

hits.name: mellin_cpow_smul
hits.type: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] (f : ℝ → E) (s a : ℂ) : mellin (fun t => ↑t ^ a • f t) s = mellin f (s + a)

hits.name: mellin_comp_rpow
hits.type: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] (f : ℝ → E) (s : ℂ) (a : ℝ) : mellin (fun t => f (t ^ a)) s = |a|⁻¹ • mellin f (s / ↑a)

hits.name: mellin_comp_mul_left
hits.type: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] (f : ℝ → E) (s : ℂ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) : mellin (fun t => f (a * t)) s = ↑a ^ (-s) • mellin f s

hits.name: mellin_comp_mul_right
hits.type: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] (f : ℝ → E) (s : ℂ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) : mellin (fun t => f (t * a)) s = ↑a ^ (-s) • mellin f s

hits.doc:
Suppose `f` is locally integrable on `(0, ∞)`, is `O(x ^ (-a))` as `x → ∞`, and is
`O(x ^ (-b))` as `x → 0`. Then its Mellin transform is differentiable on the domain `b < re s < a`.
hits.name: mellin_differentiableAt_of_isBigO_rpow
hits.type: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] {a b : ℝ} {f : ℝ → E} {s : ℂ} (hfc : MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrableOn f (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume) (hf_top : f =O[Filter.atTop] fun x => x ^ (-a)) (hs_top : s.re < a) (hf_bot : f =O[nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)] fun x => x ^ (-b)) (hs_bot : b < s.re) : DifferentiableAt ℂ (mellin f) s

hits.doc:
If `f` is locally integrable, decays exponentially at infinity, and is `O(x ^ (-b))` at 0, then
its Mellin transform is holomorphic on `b < s.re`.
hits.name: mellin_differentiableAt_of_isBigO_rpow_exp
hits.type: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {f : ℝ → E} {s : ℂ} (hfc : MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrableOn f (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume) (hf_top : f =O[Filter.atTop] fun t => Real.exp (-a * t)) (hf_bot : f =O[nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)] fun x => x ^ (-b)) (hs_bot : b < s.re) : DifferentiableAt ℂ (mellin f) s

hits.doc:
Compatibility with scalar multiplication by a normed field. For scalar multiplication by more
general rings assuming *a priori* that the Mellin transform is defined, see
`hasMellin_const_smul`.
hits.name: mellin_const_smul
hits.type: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] (f : ℝ → E) (s : ℂ) {𝕜 : Type u_2} [NormedField 𝕜] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [SMulCommClass ℂ 𝕜 E] (c : 𝕜) : mellin (fun t => c • f t) s = c • mellin f s

hits.doc:
Suppose `f` is locally integrable on `(0, ∞)`, is `O(x ^ (-a))` as `x → ∞`, and is
`O(x ^ (-b))` as `x → 0`. Then its Mellin transform is differentiable on the domain `b < re s < a`,
with derivative equal to the Mellin transform of `log • f`.
hits.name: mellin_hasDerivAt_of_isBigO_rpow
hits.type: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] {a b : ℝ} {f : ℝ → E} {s : ℂ} (hfc : MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrableOn f (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume) (hf_top : f =O[Filter.atTop] fun x => x ^ (-a)) (hs_top : s.re < a) (hf_bot : f =O[nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)] fun x => x ^ (-b)) (hs_bot : b < s.re) : MellinConvergent (fun t => Real.log t • f t) s ∧ HasDerivAt (mellin f) (mellin (fun t => Real.log t • f t) s) s

hits.name: hasMellin_const_smul
hits.type: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] {f : ℝ → E} {s : ℂ} (hf : MellinConvergent f s) {R : Type u_2} [NormedRing R] [Module R E] [IsBoundedSMul R E] [SMulCommClass ℂ R E] (c : R) : HasMellin (fun t => c • f t) s (c • mellin f s)

hits.doc: The inverse Mellin transform of the Mellin transform applied to `x > 0` is x.
hits.name: mellinInv_mellin_eq
hits.type: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E] (σ : ℝ) (f : ℝ → E) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hf : MellinConvergent f ↑σ) (hFf : Complex.VerticalIntegrable (mellin f) σ MeasureTheory.volume) (hfx : ContinuousAt f x) : mellinInv σ (mellin f) x = f x

hits.name: mellin_eq_fourier
hits.type: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] (f : ℝ → E) {s : ℂ} : mellin f s = FourierTransform.fourier (fun u => Real.exp (-s.re * u) • f (Real.exp (-u))) (s.im / (2 * Real.pi))

hits.doc: Rewrite the Gamma integral as an example of a Mellin transform.
hits.name: Complex.GammaIntegral_eq_mellin
hits.type: : Complex.GammaIntegral = mellin fun x => ↑(Real.exp (-x))

hits.doc: For strong FE-pairs, `P.Λ` is everywhere equal to the Mellin transform of `P.f`.
hits.name: IsStrongFEPair.Λ_eq
hits.type: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] {P : WeakFEPair E} (hP : IsStrongFEPair P) : P.Λ = mellin P.f

hits.name: IsStrongFEPair.symm_Λ_eq
hits.type: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] {P : WeakFEPair E} (hP : IsStrongFEPair P) : P.symm.Λ = mellin P.g

hits.doc:
Compute the Mellin transform of the modifying term used to kill off the constants at
`0` and `∞`.
hits.name: WeakFEPair.f_modif_aux2
hits.type: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] (P : WeakFEPair E) [CompleteSpace E] {s : ℂ} (hs : P.k < s.re) : mellin (fun x => P.f_modif x - P.f x + P.f₀) s = (1 / s) • P.f₀ + (P.ε / (↑P.k - s)) • P.g₀

hits.doc: Most basic version of the "Mellin transform = Dirichlet series" argument.
hits.name: hasSum_mellin
hits.type: {ι : Type u_1} [Countable ι] {a : ι → ℂ} {p : ι → ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℂ} {s : ℂ} (hp : ∀ (i : ι), a i = 0 ∨ 0 < p i) (hs : 0 < s.re) (hF : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioi 0, HasSum (fun i => a i * ↑(Real.exp (-p i * t))) (F t)) (h_sum : Summable fun i => ‖a i‖ / p i ^ s.re) : HasSum (fun i => Complex.Gamma s * a i / ↑(p i) ^ s) (mellin F s)

hits.doc:
Shortcut version for the commonly arising special case when `p i = π * q i` for some other
sequence `q`.
hits.name: hasSum_mellin_pi_mul
hits.type: {ι : Type u_1} [Countable ι] {a : ι → ℂ} {q : ι → ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℂ} {s : ℂ} (hq : ∀ (i : ι), a i = 0 ∨ 0 < q i) (hs : 0 < s.re) (hF : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioi 0, HasSum (fun i => a i * ↑(Real.exp (-Real.pi * q i * t))) (F t)) (h_sum : Summable fun i => ‖a i‖ / q i ^ s.re) : HasSum (fun i => ↑Real.pi ^ (-s) * Complex.Gamma s * a i / ↑(q i) ^ s) (mellin F s)

hits.doc: Version allowing some constant terms \(which are omitted from the sums\).
hits.name: hasSum_mellin_pi_mul₀
hits.type: {ι : Type u_1} [Countable ι] {a : ι → ℂ} {p : ι → ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℂ} {s : ℂ} (hp : ∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ p i) (hs : 0 < s.re) (hF : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioi 0, HasSum (fun i => if p i = 0 then 0 else a i * ↑(Real.exp (-Real.pi * p i * t))) (F t)) (h_sum : Summable fun i => ‖a i‖ / p i ^ s.re) : HasSum (fun i => ↑Real.pi ^ (-s) * Complex.Gamma s * a i / ↑(p i) ^ s) (mellin F s)

hits.doc: Tailored version for even Jacobi theta functions.
hits.name: hasSum_mellin_pi_mul_sq
hits.type: {ι : Type u_1} [Countable ι] {a : ι → ℂ} {r : ι → ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℂ} {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.re) (hF : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioi 0, HasSum (fun i => if r i = 0 then 0 else a i * ↑(Real.exp (-Real.pi * r i ^ 2 * t))) (F t)) (h_sum : Summable fun i => ‖a i‖ / |r i| ^ s.re) : HasSum (fun i => s.Gammaℝ * a i / ↑|r i| ^ s) (mellin F (s / 2))

hits.doc: Tailored version for odd Jacobi theta functions.
hits.name: hasSum_mellin_pi_mul_sq'
hits.type: {ι : Type u_1} [Countable ι] {a : ι → ℂ} {r : ι → ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℂ} {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.re) (hF : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioi 0, HasSum (fun i => a i * ↑(r i) * ↑(Real.exp (-Real.pi * r i ^ 2 * t))) (F t)) (h_sum : Summable fun i => ‖a i‖ / |r i| ^ s.re) : HasSum (fun i => (s + 1).Gammaℝ * a i * ↑(SignType.sign (r i)) / ↑|r i| ^ s) (mellin F ((s + 1) / 2))

hits.name: CuspForm.Λ_eq_mellin
hits.type: {Γ : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)} [Γ.IsArithmetic] {k : ℤ} (hk : 0 < k) {F : Type u_1} [FunLike F UpperHalfPlane ℂ] (f : F) [CuspFormClass F Γ k] : ModularForm.Λ hk f = mellin fun t => f (↑UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex (Complex.I * ↑t))
